Meditation Timer

A meditation timer with interval bells and a soft chime at the end, built on WebAudio — no files needed.

10:00

General information only — not medical advice. Consult a professional for personal guidance.

📖 How to use

  1. Set your session length in minutes.
  2. Optionally set an interval bell every few minutes.
  3. Press Start and settle in; press Pause any time.
  4. A soft chime marks each interval and the end of your sit.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Does it keep running in the background?

Yes — the browser keeps the timer running in this tab. For longer sits, keep the tab open and your device awake.

What is the interval bell for?

An interval bell rings every N minutes you choose, helping you notice when your mind has wandered.

Do I need to download any sounds?

No — the bell is synthesized live with WebAudio, so it works fully offline with no audio files.
